title: TS-HD-Graphics-Pack
description:
[h1]TS-HD-Graphics-Pack[/h1]
Tiberian Sun walls, gates and component towers, rebuilt as HD art, for Command & Conquer Remastered Collection mods (Red Alert). One of the asset packs from [url=https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-ra-tiberian-factions]Tiberian Factions[/url].

You do not need this pack to play Tiberian Factions: the mod already includes everything in it. It is here for other modders to use in their own mods.

[h2]Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Structures[/b] (30): TSCSAM, TSCSAMMAKE, TSCSAMT, TSCTWR, TSCTWRMAKE, TSCTWRX, TSGATEH, TSGATEHL, TSGATEHMAKE, TSGATEHX, TSGATEV, TSGATEVL, TSGATEVMAKE, TSGATEVX, TSNGATEH, TSNGATEHL, TSNGATEHMAKE, TSNGATEHX, TSNGATEV, TSNGATEVL, TSNGATEVMAKE, TSNGATEVX, TSNWALL, TSROCK, TSROCKMAKE, TSROCKT, TSVULC, TSVULCMAKE, TSVULCT, TSWALL
[/list]

[h2]Using it[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Copy the files under this pack's Data folder into your mod's Data folder, keeping the paths.
[*]Copy the entries you need from this pack's XML files into your mod's own XML files:
[list]
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/TSHD_UNITS.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_UNITS.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/TSHD_STRUCTURES.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_STRUCTURES.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/TSHD_VFX.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_VFX.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/TSHD_TERRAIN_TEMPERATE.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_TERRAIN_TEMPERATE.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/TSHD_TERRAIN_SNOW.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_TERRAIN_SNOW.XML
[*]Data/XML/TILESETS/TSHD_TERRAIN_INTERIOR.XML into Data/XML/TILESETS/RA_TERRAIN_INTERIOR.XML
[*]Data/XML/OBJECTS/UNITS/TSHDBUILDABLES.XML into Data/XML/OBJECTS/UNITS/RABUILDABLES.XML
[*]Data/XML/AUDIO/SFXEVENTSNONLOCALIZED_TSHD.XML into Data/XML/AUDIO/SFXEVENTSNONLOCALIZED.XML
[*]Data/XML/AUDIO/SFXEVENTSLOCALIZED_TSHD.XML into Data/XML/AUDIO/SFXEVENTSLOCALIZED.XML
[/list]The launcher only reads the mod's own files, so enabling the pack by itself changes nothing in game.
[*]The game also needs a classic-mode SHP for every sprite, with the same frame count. A transparent stub is enough: Tiberian Factions makes its stubs with scripts/gen_stub_shp.py ([url=https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-ra-tiberian-factions]GitHub[/url]).
[*]Units with one frame per facing, plus a turret block where they have one, use the stock layout. Units with rolling treads, walking gaits or offset turrets use Tiberian Factions' own layouts and need the matching DLL code, which is in the repo.
[/olist]
The pack's README on [url=https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-ra-tiberian-factions/tree/main/asset-packs/TS-HD-Graphics-Pack]GitHub[/url] has the same notes.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
Original Tiberian Sun assets: Electronic Arts. Prepared for Remastered by gibbo101 for Tiberian Factions.
Built from Tiberian Sun's designs by gibbo101 for Tiberian Factions.
